ops.title: Deflake rust integration test cancelling_run_reaps_the_child_with_sigterm
ops.description: Flaked once on ubuntu-latest (run 29668155673, commit 66? docs-only change — no rust touched; previous push green; rerun green). A process-reap timing assertion in rust/spawnllm/tests/integration.rs presumably races on a loaded runner. If it recurs, widen the reap deadline or poll instead of a fixed sleep.

ops.text: the test passes 50 consecutive local runs under load or carries a poll-based deadline
